description: Add socket.io-client to passenger-app and driver-app, create a TrackingSocket singleton service in each, and wire them into their respective active-trip screens. Independent of FEAT-001 for authoring but should be implemented after FEAT-001 is committed so the internal endpoint exists.
steps: Add socket.io-client to apps/passenger-app/package.json dependencies. Pin to '4.7.5' (compatible with Expo 51 / React Native 0.74). Add line: "socket.io-client": "4.7.5"

Create apps/passenger-app/services/TrackingSocket.ts. This is a singleton module (not a class exported as default instance). Export: connect(token: string): void — calls io(url, { auth: { token }, transports: ['websocket'] }) where url = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TRACKING_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3001'. Export: joinTrip(tripId: string): void — emits trip:join event. Export: leaveTrip(): void — emits trip:leave if connected. Export: onDriverMoved(cb: (data: any) => void): () => void — registers listener, returns unsubscribe fn. Export: onTripStatus(cb: (data: any) => void): () => void — same pattern. Export: onETAChanged(cb: (data: any) => void): () => void — same pattern. Export: disconnect(): void. Internal state: a single `socket: Socket | null` variable. All methods guard against null socket and log a warning if called when disconnected. Connection errors are caught and logged; they never throw.

Update apps/passenger-app/screens/TripActiveScreen.tsx. In the useEffect that runs when hasTripId is true and status becomes 'accepted'/'arriving'/'in_progress': (a) import TrackingSocket from '../services/TrackingSocket'; (b) read token with AsyncStorage.getItem('@skyrex:token') and call TrackingSocket.connect(token); (c) call TrackingSocket.joinTrip(tripId); (d) register listeners: const unsubMove = TrackingSocket.onDriverMoved(loc => { setDriverLocation({ lat: loc.latitude, lng: loc.longitude, bearing: loc.heading ?? 0, speed_kmh: loc.speed ?? 0, eta_minutes: loc.eta, progress_percent: driverLocation?.progress_percent ?? 0 }); }); const unsubStatus = TrackingSocket.onTripStatus(trip => { if (trip.status) setStatus(trip.status as TripStatus); }); const unsubETA = TrackingSocket.onETAChanged(({ newETA }) => setEtaMinutes(newETA)); (e) in the cleanup return, call unsubMove(); unsubStatus(); unsubETA(); TrackingSocket.leaveTrip(). Keep the existing 5-second setInterval polling as fallback — it already runs independently and will simply be redundant when socket is connected.
Add socket.io-client to apps/driver-app/package.json dependencies. Same version: "socket.io-client": "4.7.5"

Create apps/driver-app/src/services/TrackingSocket.ts. Singleton with: connect(token: string): void, startLocationEmit(tripId: string, getLocation: () => Promise<{ latitude: number; longitude: number; heading?: number; speed?: number }>): void — calls getLocation every 5000ms and emits driver:location:update with { driverId: decoded user id from token, latitude, longitude, heading, speed, currentTripId: tripId, timestamp: Date.now() }; decodes the driverId from the JWT payload (JSON.parse(atob(token.split('.')[1])).id), stopLocationEmit(): void — clears the interval, disconnect(): void. Internal state: socket, intervalHandle. Errors from getLocation are caught and logged silently.

Update apps/driver-app/src/screens/trip/ActiveTripScreen.tsx. Import TrackingSocket from '../../services/TrackingSocket'. In handleStartTrip (called when driver taps 'Anza Safari / Nenda'): before navigation.navigate('Navigation', ...) call AsyncStorage.getItem('@skyrex:token').then(token => { if (token) { TrackingSocket.connect(token); TrackingSocket.startLocationEmit(route.params.tripId, async () => { /* use expo-location */ const loc = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({}); return { latitude: loc.coords.latitude, longitude: loc.coords.longitude, heading: loc.coords.heading ?? undefined, speed: loc.coords.speed ?? undefined }; }); } }). In confirmPayment's onPress callback (trip completion), after setTrip({...trip, status:'completed'}) call: TrackingSocket.stopLocationEmit(); TrackingSocket.disconnect();. Also add a useEffect cleanup: return () => { TrackingSocket.stopLocationEmit(); TrackingSocket.disconnect(); }.
acceptance_criteria: apps/passenger-app/services/TrackingSocket.ts exists and exports connect, joinTrip, leaveTrip, onDriverMoved, onTripStatus, onETAChanged, disconnect
apps/passenger-app/screens/TripActiveScreen.tsx imports and uses TrackingSocket when hasTripId is true
apps/driver-app/src/services/TrackingSocket.ts exists and exports connect, startLocationEmit, stopLocationEmit, disconnect
apps/driver-app/src/screens/trip/ActiveTripScreen.tsx calls startLocationEmit on trip start and stopLocationEmit on completion
Existing polling in TripActiveScreen.tsx is still present as fallback
npx tsc --noEmit passes in both apps (0 errors)
findings: All 6 steps implemented. socket.io-client@4.7.5 added to both package.json files and manually installed into node_modules (npm install blocked by pre-existing Invalid Version bug in @react-native/community-cli-plugin@0.74.87). TrackingSocket singletons created in both apps. TripActiveScreen.tsx updated with socket listeners alongside existing polling fallback. ActiveTripScreen.tsx updated with startLocationEmit on handleStartTrip and stopLocationEmit on payment confirmation. TypeScript check passes with 0 new errors — only pre-existing errors in theme/index.ts (passenger-app) and unrelated files in driver-app.
